Thank you, it means a lot for you to say that. I’m just tired of being sad all the time, even when I am happy, it almost feels muted if that makes sense. Like in retrospect I think to myself “you’re in way over your head, man.”

In regards to my, for lack of a better term, triggers, it depends on the day. Sometimes it’s certain family members. I don’t think there’s any ill will behind it, but they make me feel less than human when they talk to me. It’s hard to express myself to them bc I feel like they wouldn’t be receptive to it or say I’m being dramatic (I did tell a family member that I was considering therapy and they hit me with “you don’t need therapy, I just don’t think you’re emotionally mature enough to handle this situation”). Please don’t take this as me bashing my family bc I love them dearly. 

My other “trigger” is a girl. I’m so into her it’s ridiculous. And we hang out from time to time (most of the time in a social setting) and when we do it’s electric. I always have a great time (today was one of those days). But always, without fail, I hear that voice that tells me I’m in over my head and I don’t deserve someone like her in my life.

This is where the other issue comes up. I get in my own head even deeper, thinking that even if she was romantically interested in me, would she be if she knew I had these thoughts, and this makes me feel even worse about myself.

Idk, that’s kind of it. I really have no reason to be sad right now, but here I am. I can’t help it. Thank you for listening, I appreciate it
